getting-started/introduction.description: Diskarte is an open-source, self-hostable community platform — text chat, voice, video and screen sharing — made for Filipino gamers, student organisations, creators and barkadas. It can run entirely
getting-started/introduction.html:
Tara, Tambay Tayo. Ang Bagong Istambayan ng Bayan. ("Come on, let's hang out. The nation's new hangout spot.")

Diskarte is an open-source, self-hostable community platform — text chat, voice, video and screen sharing — made for Filipino gamers, student organisations, creators and barkadas. It can run entirely on free tiers of Vercel (or Render), Supabase and LiveKit.

Diskarte is Filipino for resourcefulness: finding a clever way to get things done with what you have. The product leans into that — low-data mode for prepaid connections, an offline outbox for patchy signal, an installable app instead of app-store downloads, and a deployment that costs ₱0.

What you can do#

Area Highlights
Tambayans (communities) Text, voice and forum channels in categories; invite links with expiry/use limits; public discovery; templates; rules members accept before posting; welcome messages; recurring announcements; events with RSVPs and capacity; optional levels
Messaging Markdown with code highlighting, replies, threads, reactions (Pinoy glyph set + custom server emoji), attachments, voice messages, polls, pins, edits with history, stickers, GIFs, link previews, scheduled messages, slash commands, saved messages, forwarding, search
Friends and DMs Friend requests with privacy controls, favourites, nicknames, private notes, blocking, 1:1 and group DMs (up to 10) with calls and Sent/Seen receipts, 24-hour Moments
Voice and video LiveKit rooms with adaptive grid, screen share with focus mode, noise suppression and input profiles, push to talk, per-person volume, soundboard, watch parties and mini-games, ringing for DM calls
Shared workspace Channel-scoped Markdown notes, task boards, focus timers, resource lists and whiteboards with conflict detection
Moderation Bantay-Bayan auto-mod, slow mode, verification-only channels, timeouts, warnings, bans, an audit log, voice moderation, server roles and private channels
Platform A Super Admin Control Center: network roster and presence inspector, live voice rooms, broadcasts to every user, problem reports, traffic
Everywhere Installable PWA, Web Push (opt-in), themes and light mode, Filipino navigation strings, accessibility settings, keyboard navigation

Feature-by-feature detail, including what is partial or experimental, is in the feature catalogue.

Vocabulary#

Term Meaning
Tambayan A community server (from tambay, to hang out). Routes live under /tambayan
Diskarte HQ The system Tambayan every account joins automatically; hosts #announcements and #global-lounge
Bantay-Bayan The moderation toolkit ("community watch"): auto-mod, bans, audit log
Salakot The mascot's hat; the default avatars are recoloured salakot mascots
LFG "Looking for group" beacons that drop party members straight into a voice channel
Moments 24-hour text/photo updates shown to friends
Control Center The super-admin panel at /admin
Rank A member's built-in role in a Tambayan: Member, Moderator or Admin (plus the owner)
Role A custom, coloured label admins create; can grant access to private channels

Design principles#

  1. The database is the security boundary. Row Level Security, guard triggers and checked RPCs enforce every rule, so no client path can skip them. See architecture.
  2. Honest interfaces. Features that need an unapplied migration or missing configuration say so instead of failing silently; sample content on the landing page is labelled as such.
  3. Built for real connections. Optimistic sends with idempotent retries, an offline queue, reconnect recovery, low-data mode and a 30-second call rejoin.
  4. Accessible by default. Keyboard operation, visible focus, reduced motion and transparency, high contrast and axe audits in the test suite.
  5. No AI features. Diskarte has no generative or automated-moderation AI; reports are triaged by people.

Where to go next#

  • Run it locally → Quick start
  • Understand the system → Architecture overview
  • Use it → User guide
  • Deploy it → Deployment and operations
  • Contribute → Contributing

getting-started/account-and-install.html:
Create your account#

  1. Go to the Diskarte website and choose Sign up (or continue with Google/GitHub if you see those buttons).
  2. Enter your email, a username (3–32 lowercase letters, numbers, _ or . — people add you with it, like @juan.dc), a display name, and a password.
  3. Your password needs at least 10 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol. The checklist under the box turns green as you go.
  4. Check your email and tap the confirmation link (if you don't see it, look in Spam).
  5. Set up your profile: pick a salakot avatar colour or upload a photo, add a banner and a short bio.

You're now in Diskarte and already a member of Diskarte HQ. Home shows a short Getting started checklist — join or create a Tambayan, add a friend, say hello, install the app — that ticks itself off as you go. Hide it anytime with the ✕.

Sample data.

If sign-up says registrations are paused, the community running this Diskarte only accepts invited members for now.

Forgot your password? On the sign-in page choose Forgot your password?, enter your email, and follow the link we send.

Install Diskarte on your phone#

Diskarte is a web app you can install — no app store needed. Installing gives you a home-screen icon, a full-screen app and (on iPhone) notifications.

iPhone or iPad (iOS 16.4 or newer)

  1. Open Diskarte in Safari.
  2. Tap the Share button (square with an arrow).
  3. Choose Add to Home Screen, then Add.
  4. Open Diskarte from your home screen. To get notifications, go to Settings → Notifications and turn them on for this device.

Android (Chrome)

  1. Open Diskarte in Chrome.
  2. Tap the ⋮ menu → Install app (or Add to Home screen).
  3. Open it from your home screen or app drawer.

Computer (Chrome or Edge) — click the install icon in the address bar, or Settings → Storage & Data → Install Diskarte.

Updating: when a new version is ready, Settings → Storage & Data shows Reload to update. Finish any call first.

Customize your profile#

Open User settings (gear next to your name, bottom left; on phones, the Profile tab):

  • My Profile — avatar, banner, display name, bio.
  • Status — click your avatar in the bottom-left panel to set Online, Idle, Do Not Disturb or Invisible, or pick a fun status like Nagluto ng Canton or Nasa jeep, mahina signal. Choose Clear after 30 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours or 24 hours so you don't forget it.
  • Appearance — themes (Solar, Bayan, Neon, Ube, Sampaguita, Kalikasan) and dark, light or system mode.
  • Language & Region — English or Filipino menus, and your time zone.

Find your way around#

On a computer On a phone
Left edge: your Tambayans. Next column: channels or your DMs. Middle: the conversation. Right: members Bottom tabs: Home, Messages, Explore, Profile. Swipe from the left edge to open channels
Ctrl + K (Windows) or ⌘ K (Mac) jumps to any channel or conversation Tap a conversation to open it full screen

Sample data.

What's new: after an update, Home shows a short summary until you've seen it, and the full post is in Diskarte HQ's #announcements channel (marked Official).

Slow or expensive internet? Settings → Storage & Data → Low-data mode loads smaller images, stops GIFs from autoplaying and lowers video quality.

guides.html:
Plain-language help for using Diskarte. No technical knowledge needed.

Guide You'll learn to
Getting started Create an account, install Diskarte on your phone or computer, set up your profile
Tambayans Create a Tambayan, invite friends, set up channels and run your community
Messages Send messages, photos and voice notes, reply, react, search, schedule messages
Calls Join voice channels, call friends, share your screen
Events and Moments Schedule events, RSVP, and share 24-hour Moments
Shared workspace Keep notes, task boards, focus timers, links and a whiteboard with your group
Notifications, privacy and safety Control alerts, choose who can add you, block people, protect your account, download or delete your data

Words you'll see

  • Tambayan — a community (like a server or group). You can be in up to 100.
  • Channel — a room inside a Tambayan: text (#), voice (speaker icon) or forum.
  • Diskarte HQ — the official Tambayan everyone is in, for announcements.
  • DM — a direct message between you and friends.
  • Moderator / Admin / Owner — people who help run a Tambayan.

Something not working? Settings → Report a problem sends a note to the Diskarte team.

guides/tambayans.title: Tambayans
guides/tambayans.description: People who were banned can't rejoin with any link.
guides/tambayans.html:
Create a Tambayan#

  1. Click Add a server (the + on the left rail; on phones, from Home).
  2. Give it a name and short description.
  3. Pick a template — Gaming crew, Study group, Creator community, Friend group, or Organization / team. Every template comes with a general chat and a voice channel; some add channels for resources and discussions.
  4. Done — you're the owner. Change anything later in Server settings.

Invite friends#

  • Right-click your Tambayan (long-press on phones) → Invite people, or Copy invite link.
  • Choose how long the link works (30 minutes up to "never") and how many people can use it.
  • Friends open the link, sign in and join. You can also send the invite straight to a friend's DMs.
  • Want strangers to find you? Admins can list the Tambayan in Explore with a category (Gaming, Study, Creators, Friends, Music, Tech, Anime, Sports, Other).

People who were banned can't rejoin with any link.

Screen new members (admins). Server settings → Membership: add up to 5 joining questions and, if you like, turn on Moderators approve new members. People joining then see your rules and questions first. With approval on, moderators review requests in the same tab (a "people want to join" button appears in the channel list when someone's waiting) and approve or decline them.

Sample data.

Set up channels#

Right-click the channel list → Create channel:

  • Text for chatting, Voice for calls, Forum for titled posts with their own threads.
  • Group channels into categories and drag them to reorder.
  • Edit a channel to add a topic, slow mode (how often each person may post), read-only (only moderators post), or verified accounts only.
  • Admins can make a channel private and choose which people or roles can see it.

Roles and helpers#

Every member has a rank:

Rank Can
Member Chat, react, join calls, make invites, RSVP
Moderator Also pin and delete messages, time out, warn, kick and ban members, manage channels, see the audit log
Admin Also change settings, ranks and private channels
Owner Everything, including deleting or transferring the Tambayan

Change someone's rank or give them a custom role (a coloured label) by right-clicking them in the member list. Roles can unlock private channels.

Run your community#

Open Server settings from the Tambayan's menu. Admins see every tab; moderators see the audit log, bans and invites.

Sample data.

Tab Use it to
Overview Name, icon, description, Explore listing, rules, welcome message, levels, export settings
Roles Create coloured roles
Bantay-Bayan Turn on auto-moderation: spam, scam links, hate speech, explicit content, and your own blocked words
Audit log See who did what (joins, kicks, bans, deleted messages, auto-mod blocks…)
Bans See bans and lift them
Invites See and revoke invite links
Emoji Upload up to 50 custom emoji
Soundboard Upload short MP3 clips for calls
Webhooks Let other apps post into a channel
Announcements Post a message automatically every day or every week
Support Add GCash/Maya numbers and grant supporter badges

Rules: if you write rules, members must accept them before they can post. Change the rules and everyone is asked again.

Welcome messages: greet new members automatically. Use {user} for their name and {server} for the Tambayan's name, e.g. Mabuhay {user}! Welcome sa {server}.

Levels: members earn points for chatting (at most once a minute, so spamming doesn't help). A leaderboard shows the most active members. You can reset for a new season.

Keep it safe#

Right-click a member for:

  • Timeout (60 seconds to a week) — they can read but not talk.
  • Warn — they see your note once.
  • Kick or Ban (with a reason).
  • In a voice channel: mute, deafen, disconnect or move them.

You can only act on people with a lower rank than yours. Everything is written to the audit log.

Leave or delete#

  • Leave server from the Tambayan's menu. Owners must hand the Tambayan to someone else or delete it first.
  • Delete (owner only) removes all channels and messages permanently.

guides/messages.title: Messages
guides/messages.description: Type in the box at the bottom and press Enter. Shift + Enter starts a new line.
guides/messages.html:
Send a message#

Type in the box at the bottom and press Enter. Shift + Enter starts a new line.

Sample data.

  • Mention someone with @username. Moderators can use @everyone, @here or a role.
  • Format text with Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, `code`, ``` for code blocks, ||spoiler|| to hide something until clicked.
  • Attach photos, videos, MP3s (up to 10 files, 10 MB each) with the paperclip.
  • Voice message: tap Record a voice message (mic button) and record up to 5 minutes.
  • Stickers and GIFs: open the sticker or GIF picker; picking one sends it right away.
  • Polls: ask a question with 2–10 answers, open for an hour up to a week.
  • Shortcuts: start a message with /shrug, /tableflip, /unflip, /me or /spoiler (press Tab to complete).

Links show a preview card. To hide a preview, wrap the link in < and >.

No signal? Keep typing and sending — messages wait in a queue (you'll see an 8-bit "offline" bar) and send automatically when you're back online. If one fails, tap Retry.

Why didn't my message send?

You see Why
"Slow mode — you can send again in …" The channel limits how often people post
"Accept this server's rules first" Open the rules card above the message box and accept
"You're sending too fast" Wait a few seconds
A lock instead of the message box You're timed out, or only moderators can post here
The message vanished Auto-moderation blocked it (spam, scam link or blocked word)

Reply, react and more#

Hover a message (long-press on phones) for actions:

  • Reply (or swipe right on a phone).
  • React with Pinoy reactions like petmalu, lodi, sana all, or the Tambayan's custom emoji.
  • Start thread to move a side discussion into its own panel.
  • Edit or Delete your own messages. Edited messages show "(edited)"; you and moderators can see the earlier versions.
  • Pin (moderators) — see all pins from the pin icon in the channel header.
  • Save Message to bookmark it for yourself.
  • Forward to another channel or a DM.
  • Mark Unread to come back later.

Forum channels#

Each new post needs a title. Replies go inside the post. Pinned posts stay on top, then the most active ones.

  • Tags: pick up to 5 of the forum's tags when you post, or open your post to change them. Tap a tag above the list to show only those posts.
  • Solved: open your question and tap Mark solved once it's answered.
  • Suggestion boards: some forums collect ideas. Tap the arrow to upvote (tap again to take it back), use Top to see the most wanted ideas, and watch for the status a moderator sets: Under consideration, Planned, In progress, Completed or Declined.
  • Moderators: the ⚙ button sets the forum's kind and its tags.

Remind me#

Right-click (long-press on phones) any message → Remind me… → pick a time. Diskarte saves the message and pops up a reminder with an Open button when it's time. Reminders show while Diskarte is open; if it's closed, you'll see it next time you open the app. Find pending reminders under Notifications → Saved.

Schedule a message#

In a text channel, open Schedule message next to the send button, write the message and pick a time up to 30 days ahead (you can have 25 waiting). Open Scheduled messages to see, cancel or check failed ones. A scheduled message posts as you, following the channel's rules; if it can't (for example you were timed out), it stays in the list with the reason. Scheduling isn't available in DMs.

Search#

  • In a Tambayan: use the search box in the channel header. Add from:username or in:channel to narrow it down.
  • Everywhere: the Search page searches every Tambayan and DM you can read, with filters for sender, dates and media type.

Click a result to jump to that exact message.

Direct messages#

  • Add friends first: Friends → Add Friend → their @username.
  • Message a friend from their profile or the Messages tab. Start a group DM with up to 9 friends.
  • Under your latest message you'll see Sent or Seen.
  • Right-click a DM to mark it read, see the person's options, or leave a group.

Hangouts#

A Hangout is a quick, temporary space for you and up to 9 friends — chat plus a call — that cleans itself up afterwards.

  1. On Home, tap Start a Hangout (or the ✦ next to a friend who's around).
  2. Pick what it's for, who's coming and how long (1, 3 or 8 hours).
  3. Leave Jump into voice on to join the call right away and ring everyone.

Anyone in it can add an hour. The host can Keep it (it becomes a normal group chat), Make it a Tambayan (everyone gets an invite), or End it. When the time runs out, the hangout and its messages are deleted. Files can't be shared in a hangout until it's kept.

Sample data.

Unread messages#

A white dot means new messages; a red number means someone mentioned you. Right-click a Tambayan → Mark As Read, or use Mark all as read in your inbox.

guides/calls.title: Voice and video calls
guides/calls.html:
Join a voice channel#

  1. Click a channel with the speaker icon. You'll see who's inside.
  2. Click Join. Allow microphone access the first time.
  3. You stay in the call while you look at other channels, other Tambayans or your DMs.

Sample data.

Hover a Tambayan's icon (or long-press it and choose Voice activity) to see who's talking before you join.

Leave with Disconnect in the "Voice Connected" panel (bottom left) or the call strip on phones.

Call a friend#

Open a DM or group DM and press the call button. Everyone else in the conversation sees a ringing pop-up for 45 seconds and can accept or decline.

During a call#

Button What it does
Mic Mute / unmute
Headphones Deafen (you hear nothing and can't talk)
Camera Turn your video on/off
Screen Share your screen or a window/tab (with sound if your browser allows). Click a shared screen to watch it; use focus mode for full screen
Mixer Change the volume of each person, mute someone just for you, or stop seeing their video
Soundboard Play a short sound everyone hears
Activities Watch YouTube together, play Tic-Tac-Toe or Pinoy Trivia

The signal bars show your connection quality; tap them for details.

Settings → Voice & Video lets you choose your microphone and speakers, test your mic, pick a noise setting (Isolation for noisy places, Studio for good mics) and turn on push to talk (hold a key to speak).

Tips for weak connections#

  • Turn on Low-data mode (Settings → Storage & Data): video uses less data.
  • Turn your camera off; audio uses very little data.
  • If the page reloads during a call, Diskarte reconnects you automatically.
  • No sound after reconnecting? Click the turn on sound button.

Moderators#

Right-click someone in a voice channel to mute, deafen, disconnect or move them to another channel.

guides/events-and-moments.title: Events and Moments
guides/events-and-moments.description: See events: the Events row in a Tambayan's channel list shows how many are coming up (or LIVE when one has started).
guides/events-and-moments.html:
Events#

See events: the Events row in a Tambayan's channel list shows how many are coming up (or LIVE when one has started).

RSVP: open an event and press Interested. If the event has a limit and it's full, you'll see that. With notifications on, Diskarte reminds you 15 minutes before it starts.

Add to your calendar: the Calendar button downloads a file your phone or computer calendar can import.

Create an event (moderators):

  1. Open Events → schedule a new event.
  2. Give it a name, description, start and end time, and either a voice channel or another location.
  3. Optional: set a capacity (how many people can say they're coming).
  4. Optional: Repeat weekly for 4, 8 or 12 weeks — Diskarte creates each week as its own event, so you can change or cancel one without affecting the others.

Events in a private channel are only visible to people who can see that channel.

Moments#

Moments are short updates — text, a photo, or both — that disappear after 24 hours. Find them on Home.

  • Share a moment: choose who sees it: all your friends or only your favourites. You can have up to 10 live moments.
  • Mute someone to stop seeing their moments without unfriending them.
  • Report a moment that breaks the rules; the Diskarte team reviews it.
  • Delete your own moment anytime from its options.

Mark friends as favourites from your Friends list.

guides/workspace.title: Shared workspace
guides/workspace.description: Every Tambayan has a workspace for planning and studying together. Open it from the Tambayan's menu or channel list. Everything belongs to a text channel, and anyone who can see that channel can see i
guides/workspace.html:
Every Tambayan has a workspace for planning and studying together. Open it from the Tambayan's menu or channel list. Everything belongs to a text channel, and anyone who can see that channel can see its documents.

Sample data.

Tool Good for
Note Meeting notes, reviewers, guides (Markdown)
Task board To do / Doing / Done cards for a project or event
Focus timer A shared study or work session (1–120 minutes) everyone counts down together
Resources A list of useful links (https only) with descriptions
Whiteboard Quick sketches and diagrams

Editing together: when two people change the same document, Diskarte doesn't silently overwrite anyone. If someone saved while you were editing, you'll see their version and choose whether to keep yours or theirs. Your unsaved text stays until you decide.

Can't edit? You might be timed out, the channel might be read-only, or it might require a verified email. On phones, editors open full screen; leaving with unsaved changes asks first.

guides/notifications-and-privacy.title: Notifications, privacy and safety
guides/notifications-and-privacy.html:
Notifications#

Open Settings → Notifications:

Sample data.

  • Desktop notifications for new DMs while Diskarte is open in a tab.
  • Sounds — the little 8-bit beeps. Change the volume from the speaker button next to your name.
  • Quiet hours — no sounds, rings or alerts between times you choose.
  • Pause for 1 hour — a quick break.
  • This device (push notifications) — get alerts even when Diskarte is closed. Choose which kinds: DMs, mentions, replies, friend requests, invitations, calls, events, moderation and security. Previews are off by default, so your lock screen just says "Diskarte"; turn them on to see who wrote and what.

On iPhone, install Diskarte to your home screen first (see Getting started). Push notifications also depend on your phone's focus modes and battery settings.

Per Tambayan: Only @mentions, Nothing, or Mute Server (until you unmute, or Mute for 1 hour / Mute for 8 hours). This lives in the Tambayan's menu under Notification Settings. Right-click a channel → Mute Channel.

Privacy#

  • Who can add you: Settings → Privacy & Safety → everyone, only people in a Tambayan with you, or nobody.

Sample data.

  • DMs only come from friends.
  • Friend nicknames and notes you add are visible only to you.
  • Favourites are private too.
  • Show friends when I'm around (Settings → Privacy & Safety): turn it off and friends won't see you as online or which voice channel you're in on their Home. Invisible always hides you.
  • Seen receipts in DMs can't be turned off yet.

Blocking#

Right-click someone → Block. They can't message you or send you friend requests, and to them it looks like your account doesn't exist. Unblock from the same menu.

Protect your account#

  • Use a strong, unique password.
  • Turn on two-factor sign-in: Settings → My Account → Two-factor, then scan the code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password…). After that you'll enter a 6-digit code when you sign in. Keep your authenticator safe — losing it means asking an administrator for help.
  • Settings → Devices & Sessions → sign out everywhere if you used a shared computer.

Your data#

  • Download everything: Settings → Storage & Data → Request all of my data gives you a file with everything your account wrote or set.
  • Delete your account: Settings → My Account → Danger zone. Type your username to confirm. Your files and private data are deleted. If you own Tambayans, they pass to their most senior member (or are deleted if nobody else is in them). This can't be undone.

Report a problem#

Settings → Report a problem: choose what kind of problem, describe what happened, and send. The Diskarte team reviews every report.

features.html:
Every user-facing feature, its status, where it lives and how it is tested. Status is based on the code in main and the release notes, not on plans.

Status Meaning
Shipped Implemented, covered by automated tests, usable once its migration is applied
Needs setup Implemented, but only works after optional configuration (env vars, cron, Vault)
Partial Works with documented gaps
Not implemented Asked for or implied elsewhere, but not in the code

Pages#

Page Covers
Messaging Text and forum channels, composer, replies, threads, reactions, attachments, voice messages, polls, pins, edits, stickers, GIFs, link previews, slash commands, scheduled messages, search, saved messages, forwarding, unreads
Friends, DMs and profiles Profiles, statuses, friends, privacy, nicknames, notes, favourites, blocking, DMs and group DMs, read receipts, Moments
Tambayans Servers, channels, ranks and roles, private channels, invites, discovery, templates, rules, welcome messages, announcements, events, levels, emoji, soundboard, support badges, LFG, webhooks
Moderation and administration Bantay-Bayan auto-mod, slow mode, verification gates, timeouts, warnings, bans, audit log, voice moderation, problem reports, the Super Admin Control Center
Voice and video Joining calls, screen share, devices, push to talk, mixer, activities, rings, previews
Shared workspace Notes, task boards, focus timers, resources, whiteboards

Feature Status Notes

GIF search Needs setup GIPHY_API_KEY

Search (server and global) Shipped
Unreads, mentions, Mark Unread, Mark all read Shipped
Friends, blocking, privacy, nicknames, notes, favourites Shipped
DMs and group DMs (≤ 10), DM media Shipped
DM read receipts (Sent / Seen) Partial No opt-out
Instant Hangouts (temporary group chat + call, 1–24 h) Shipped Needs migration 20261108000000; no files while temporary; purge also runs with the platform job
Friends who are around (Home) Shipped Heartbeat-based; respects Invisible and the "Show friends when I'm around" setting
Custom status with expiry Shipped Offline users' statuses clear only with the cron job
Moments Partial Purged photos stay in Storage until account deletion
Tambayans, channels, categories, reordering Shipped
Ranks, custom roles, private channels Shipped
Invites (permanent + limited) Shipped
Discovery (Explore) Shipped
Templates and settings export Shipped
Server rules Shipped
Membership screening (joining questions, moderator approval) Shipped Needs migration 20261108010000
Welcome messages Shipped

Community levels (XP) Shipped Off by default
Custom emoji, soundboard, support badges, LFG Shipped
Incoming channel webhooks Shipped Incoming only; no outgoing webhooks or bot accounts
Automation builder (triggers/conditions/actions) Not implemented Welcome messages and recurring announcements only
Bot accounts, OAuth apps, interactive slash commands Not implemented
Auto-mod, slow mode, verification gates, timeouts, warnings, bans, audit log Shipped
Voice moderation (mute, deafen, disconnect, move) Shipped Can't move into private channels
Problem reports and Control Center Shipped Manual triage; the earlier automated "fix agent" was removed
Voice/video calls, screen share, DM calls, rings Shipped Not verified on physical phones

Soundboard, watch party, Tic-Tac-Toe, trivia Shipped
Recording, transcription, E2E encryption Not implemented
Shared notes, boards, focus timers, resources, whiteboards Shipped
Collaborative real-time co-editing (CRDT/OT) Not implemented Revision checks with explicit conflict resolution instead
MFA (TOTP), sessions, sign out everywhere Shipped

Themes, light/system mode, accessibility settings Shipped

PWA install, offline fallback, offline outbox Shipped Conversations aren't readable offline
Web Push Needs setup Production configuration and physical-device delivery unverified
Native mobile apps Not implemented The PWA is the mobile app
Help Center (/docs) with search and in-app help links Shipped Public; documents main
Getting started checklist on Home Shipped Derived from account data; dismissal is per browser
What's New card and official release posts in Diskarte HQ Needs setup Posts need RELEASE_ANNOUNCEMENTS=on, the service role key and migration 20261107000000

Feature page format#

Each feature section on these pages answers the same questions in this order, so they are quick to scan and easy to keep current (see the feature doc template):

What it does · How to use it · Behaviour and limits · Code · Data and permissions · Errors and recovery · Tests · Known limitations

features/messaging.title: Messaging
features/messaging.description: Text and forum channels inside a Tambayan. DMs share most of this machinery and are covered in Friends, DMs and profiles. The delivery pipeline (optimistic sends, offline queue, recovery) is in Realti
features/messaging.html:
Text and forum channels inside a Tambayan. DMs share most of this machinery and are covered in Friends, DMs and profiles. The delivery pipeline (optimistic sends, offline queue, recovery) is in Realtime and message delivery.

Main code: ChatView, Composer, MessageItem, VirtualMessageList, useChannelChat, actions/messages.ts, lib/messages.ts. Tables: messages, reactions, message_mentions, message_edits, polls, poll_votes, saved_messages, channel_reads, scheduled_messages.

Sending messages#

What it does. Posts Markdown text (≤ 4,000 characters), up to 10 attachments, a sticker or a GIF into a text channel, or a titled post into a forum channel.

How to use it. Type in the composer and press Enter (Shift+Enter for a new line). Drafts are kept per conversation and synced to your account (text only, never files). Mention people with @username; moderators can use @everyone, @here and @{Role name}.

Behaviour and limits.

Rule Limit Enforced by
Length 4,000 characters (control characters stripped, trimmed) Zod + messages_content_check
Not empty Text, an attachment or a sticker messages_not_empty
Rate 20 / 10 s per user (app), 8 / 10 s per user across channels (database) limiters.message, messages_before_insert
Slow mode One message per channel per N seconds; moderators exempt messages_before_insert_community
Read-only channels Moderators only messages_read_only_guard
Verification-only channels Confirmed email/phone required messages_before_insert_community
Timeouts Can read but not send/react/talk timeout_send_guard
Server rules Must be accepted (moderators exempt) messages_rules_guard
@everyone / @here Only honoured from moderators messages_mentions_before_insert

Consecutive messages from the same author within 7 minutes are grouped. Times render in Philippine time on the server and switch to your own time zone after hydration (no hydration mismatch).

Errors and recovery. Refused sends show the reason and put your text back in the composer (slow mode starts a countdown). Network failures keep the message with Retry / Discard; offline sends are queued and flush automatically. Auto-mod blocks are silent to the author by design.

Tests. src/hooks/__tests__/useChannelChat.test.tsx, src/components/chat/__tests__/chat-ui.test.tsx, tests/db/schema.test.ts, tests/db/security.test.ts, tests/db/community.test.ts, e2e/server-chat.spec.ts.

Markdown rendering#

GitHub-flavoured Markdown with highlighted code blocks, spoilers (||text||, revealed on click unless Settings → Chat says "always"), and links limited to http(s): / mailto: with rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow ugc". Raw HTML is shown as literal text — it is never parsed (MessageMarkdown.tsx, tests in src/components/chat/__tests__/markdown.test.tsx and spoilers.test.tsx).

Slash commands#

Built-in text transforms in the composer (lib/slash-commands.ts); Tab completes the command name. Unknown commands are sent as typed (so /r/philippines still works).

Command Result
/shrug [text] Appends ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
/tableflip [text] Appends (╯°□°)╯︵ ┻━┻
/unflip [text] Appends ┬─┬ノ( º _ ºノ)
/me text Italic action text
/spoiler text Wraps the text in a spoiler

There are no bot or app commands.

Replies and threads#

  • Reply: hover/long-press → Reply, or swipe right on phones. A reply to a message in another channel is silently dropped to a plain message.
  • Thread: start one from any top-level message; it opens in a side panel (full screen on phones, ThreadPanel). The root shows "N replies"; counters are trigger-maintained. Threads can't be nested (INVALID_THREAD).

Forum channels#

Every top-level message is a post with a 1–100 character title (POST_TITLE_REQUIRED otherwise); replies go in the post's thread. Pinned posts come first, then latest activity (ForumView). Slow mode, auto-mod, timeouts and unreads apply.

Feature Who Detail
Forum kind and tags Moderators (forum ⚙) Discussion or Suggestion board; up to 12 tags, 20 characters, case-insensitively unique (set_forum_settings). Removing a tag takes it off every post
Tagging a post Its author or a moderator Up to 5 of the forum's tags, when posting or from the open post (set_forum_post)
Solved Its author or a moderator Discussion forums only
Votes and statuses Members vote; moderators set statuses Suggestion boards only (toggle_forum_vote); see suggestion boards
Filters Everyone Search, tag chips, status filter and Top sorting

State lives in forum_post_state and forum_votes (readable by whoever can view the channel, written only through the functions, deleted with the post); forum_overview(channel) returns tags, status and vote totals. Migration 20261108020000_forum_tags_suggestions.sql. Tests: tests/db/forum.test.ts, tests/db/forum-suggestions.test.ts, tests/ui/forum.test.tsx.

Reactions#

Reactions are glyph codes, not emoji: the Pinoy set (:petmalu:, :lodi:, :sana_all:, :charot:, :canton:…), classic reactions, and the server's custom emoji. Up to 20 distinct reactions per message (TOO_MANY_REACTIONS). The right-click menu has a quick row (:thumbs_up:, :heart:, :laugh:, :petmalu:). Settings → Chat can hide reactions. lib/emoji.ts, ReactionBar.

Attachments and media#

  • Up to 10 files per message, 10 MB each: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP3, MP4, WebM/Ogg/MP4 audio.
  • Files are checked by magic bytes in the browser, then by the action, the database trigger and the Storage policy. They live in the private attachments bucket at <server>/<channel>/<uploader>/<uuid>.<ext> and are shown through short-lived signed URLs (useSignedUrls).
  • Images open in the media viewer with a gallery of the conversation's media (MediaViewer).
  • Low-data mode serves smaller images, doesn't autoplay GIFs and doesn't preload videos.
  • Deleting a message also deletes its files (uploader or a moderator).

Voice messages#

Record up to 5 minutes from the composer (VoiceRecorder); the browser picks WebM/Opus, Ogg/Opus or MP4/AAC (Safari) at 32 kbps. They're uploaded as ordinary attachments. Test: src/components/chat/__tests__/voice-recorder.test.tsx, tests/db/voice-messages.test.ts.

Polls#

The composer's poll button creates a message whose text is the question, with 2–10 answers, single or multiple choice, open for 1 h, 4 h, 8 h, 24 h, 3 days or a week (create_poll, vote_poll). Results update live over db:chat:<channel>:poll-<message>. Tests: tests/db/polls.test.ts, tests/ui/polls.test.tsx.

Stickers, GIFs and link previews#

  • Stickers: two built-in packs (Salitang Kanto, Tambayan Classics) drawn as SVG; the database stores only the sticker id.
  • GIFs: GIPHY search via /api/gifs (needs GIPHY_API_KEY, PG-13). A message that is only a GIPHY link renders as the GIF.
  • Link previews: the first 3 distinct links outside code get a card via /api/unfurl (SSRF-guarded). Wrapping a link in <angle brackets> suppresses its preview; Settings → Chat can turn previews off. Test: src/components/chat/__tests__/link-embeds.test.tsx, tests/security/unfurl-routes.test.ts.

Editing, deleting and pinning#

Action Who Notes
Edit Author "(edited)" mark; previous versions kept in message_edits, viewable by the author and moderators (EditHistory)
Delete Author or moderator Logged in the audit log with an excerpt when a moderator deletes
Pin Moderators Pins drawer lists them live (PinsDrawer)

Scheduled messages#

What. Text-only messages for text channels, scheduled up to 30 days ahead, at most 25 pending per person. How. Composer → schedule; the channel's scheduled list shows pending and failed items with cancel. Behaviour. At send_at the row is published as you by publish_scheduled_messages(), so every live-send rule applies; a refused message stays in the list with failed_reason (timed out, slow mode, lost access, auto-mod). Your open app publishes your own due messages; the minute cron job publishes everyone's (background jobs). Limits. Not available in DMs; no attachments. Tests. tests/db/scheduled-messages.test.ts, tests/ui/scheduled-messages.test.tsx.

Search#

Search Where Syntax / filters
In a Tambayan Search box in the channel header (SearchBox) Words (prefix match), from:username, in:channel; unknown filters stay as words
Everywhere /tambayan/search (GlobalSearchView) Words, community (or all communities and DMs), sender username, date range, media type (attachments, images, audio, video)

Both run search_messages / search_all_messages with invoker rights over simple-dictionary full-text indexes, so RLS keeps private channels, other servers and other people's DMs out. Clicking a result opens the exact message in context (MessageContext) without breaking live history. Tests: tests/db/search.test.ts, tests/ui/search.test.tsx, tests/ui/global-search.test.tsx, tests/community/search-parse.test.ts.

Unreads, mentions and inbox#

  • Unread pills and red mention counts on channels and the server rail, from my_unreads().
  • Mark Unread (from a message), Mark As Read (a server) and Mark all as read (everything, including DMs).
  • The Activity view (Notification hub) groups Inbox, Mentions and Saved, with channel mention deep links (NotificationHub).
  • Read receipts are durable and "read up to" a time — see Realtime and message delivery.

Tests: tests/db/unreads.test.ts, tests/db/mark-all-read.test.ts, tests/db/notification-read-state.test.ts, tests/ui/unreads.test.tsx, src/lib/__tests__/read-receipts.test.ts.

Saved and forwarded messages#

  • Save Message bookmarks a message privately (saved_messages); you only see it while you can still read the channel (SavedMessages).
  • Remind me… saves the message with a reminder time (20 minutes, 1 or 3 hours, tomorrow 9:00 or next week; saved_messages.remind_at). While Diskarte is open it checks every minute, shows a toast with Open (and a desktop notification if enabled), then clears the reminder; Saved shows pending reminders (Reminders.tsx). Reminders that come due while the app is closed appear the next time you open it — there's no push for them. Migration 20261108030000_message_reminders.sql.
  • Forward posts a quote ("Forwarded from author in #channel") to a channel in the same server or one of your DMs; attachments are not copied. Tests: tests/db/saved-messages.test.ts, tests/ui/forward-saved.test.tsx.

Known limitations#

  • No message translation, bookmarks folders, or message scheduling or reminders in DMs.
  • Reminders aren't pushed to closed apps; forum subscriptions ("follow a post") don't exist yet.
  • Link preview cache is per server instance (1 hour).
  • Search uses the simple text configuration: no stemming or Filipino/English-specific language rules.
  • Offline, previously loaded conversations aren't available; only sending is queued.

features/social.title: Friends, DMs and profiles
features/social.description: Main code: SocialProvider (one app-wide subscription to friendships and conversations), useSocial, FriendsView, DmView, useDirectChat, actions/social.ts, lib/social.ts. Tables: profiles, friendships,
features/social.html:
Main code: SocialProvider (one app-wide subscription to friendships and conversations), useSocial, FriendsView, DmView, useDirectChat, actions/social.ts, lib/social.ts. Tables: profiles, friendships, user_blocks, privacy_settings, friend_nicknames, friend_favourites, user_notes, dm_conversations, dm_participants, direct_messages, moments, moment_mutes, call_rings.

Profiles#

What. Display name, unique @username (3–32 of a–z 0–9 _ ., lower-cased), avatar (a recoloured salakot mascot preset or an uploaded image), banner (preset or image), bio, presence and custom status. Where. Settings → My Profile (ProfileBuilder); others see a popout card (ProfileCard) from member lists, messages and context menus. On someone else's card: mutual friends, shared Tambayans (Diskarte HQ excluded), their level in this Tambayan if levels are on, badges, and your private note. Data. Any signed-in user can read profiles; you can only update your own row. Uploaded images go to the public avatars bucket under your user id; image URLs must be https:// without quotes or parentheses.

Presence and custom status#

Control Behaviour
Status Online, Idle, Do Not Disturb, Invisible (presence_status), shown as a pixel ring and roster dot
Filipino status triggers One click sets text + matching presence, e.g. "Nagluto ng Canton" (idle), "AFK / Tulog" (idle), "LFG / Pa-carry" (online), "Nag-aaral pa boffum" (DND), "Nasa jeep, mahina signal", "Brownout / Bumabagyo"
Clear after 30 min, 1 h, 4 h, 24 h or never. Your open app clears it on time; the cron job clears it for people who are offline

Super admins can override someone's status from the Control Center (audited). Tests: tests/db/profile-connections.test.ts, src/lib/__tests__/profile.test.ts, tests/ui/StatusHighlight.test.tsx.

Friends#

How. Friends tab → Add Friend by @username, or Add Friend on a profile card / person menu. Requests appear as incoming/outgoing; accept, decline or cancel. Rules (database). The recipient's Settings → Privacy & Safety decides who may send requests: everyone, people who share a Tambayan with them (Diskarte HQ doesn't count), or nobody. Blocks hide everything both ways — to the blocked person a block looks like "user not found". Extras.

Feature Visibility
Favourites Private to you; favourites are listed first and can be a Moments audience
Friend nicknames Private name shown only to you in friends and DMs
Server nicknames members.nickname, visible to the whole Tambayan
Notes Private note about anyone (user_notes)

Tests: tests/db/friend-nicknames.test.ts, tests/db/user-notes.test.ts, tests/db/privacy.test.ts, tests/db/community.test.ts (friendships, blocks), tests/ui/ContextMenus.test.tsx.

Direct messages and group DMs#

What. 1:1 and group conversations (3–10 people) with the same composer as channels: Markdown, replies, edits, deletes, stickers, GIFs, voice messages and private media. How. Message button on a friend's card or the Messages tab; New group DM picks 2–9 friends. Right-click a DM for mark read, the person's menu or leave (groups).

Rule Detail
Who can start 1:1: accepted friends with no block either way (open_dm). Groups: every invitee must be your friend and not blocked (create_group_dm, add_to_group_dm → DM_NOT_ALLOWED)
Size 10 participants (INVALID_GROUP_SIZE)
One 1:1 per pair dm_conversations.direct_key is unique
Reading Participants only (is_dm_participant), including Realtime db:dm:<id>
Editing / deleting Author only
Rate 8 messages / 10 s per user
Media Private attachments bucket under dm/<conversation>/<uploader>/…, readable only by participants
Blocking Ends the ability to message in that conversation

Read receipts. Under your latest message: Sent or Seen (with names in groups), from dm_participants.last_read_at, which fellow participants can read. There is no opt-out yet.

Calls. The call button rings everyone else in the conversation for 45 s; see Voice and video.

Invitations. The Invite dialog can send a Tambayan invite as a DM; it renders as an invite card (direct_messages.invite_server_id).

Notifications. Unread dots, a sound, an optional desktop notification (DmNotifier) and Web Push when configured.

Tests: tests/db/dm-attachments.test.ts, tests/ui/dm-notifier.test.tsx, e2e/server-chat.spec.ts.

Instant Hangouts#

What. A temporary space for right now: text chat plus the DM call room (voice, video, screen share, soundboard and activities such as watch party), for you and 1–9 friends, lasting 1, 3 or 8 hours. How. Home → Start a Hangout (or the button in the Home sidebar, or the ✦ next to a friend on Home) → what it's for (Just hanging, Gaming, Study, Project, Watch party, Create) → who → how long → optionally Jump into voice, which joins the call and rings everyone picked.

Rule Detail
What it is A group conversation (dm_conversations.kind = 'group') with hangout_until and hangout_topic set; created by create_hangout
Who Accepted friends with no block either way (DM_NOT_ALLOWED); 2–10 people including you
How many 3 live hangouts hosted at once per person (RATE_LIMITED)
Extend Any participant: +1 hour (extend_hangout), never more than 24 hours from now
Keep The host: Keep clears the end time; it becomes an ordinary group DM
Make it a Tambayan The host: creates a Tambayan from the matching template and posts its invite in the hangout
End The host: End deletes the conversation and its messages for everyone (end_hangout)
Time's up Sending stops (HANGOUT_ENDED), it leaves everyone's lists, and purge_expired_hangouts deletes it (run by the platform job and whenever someone starts a hangout)
Files Not while temporary (can_upload_dm_attachment is false), so a purge never leaves files behind; GIFs, stickers and links work

Code: Hangouts.tsx, lib/hangouts.ts, actions in actions/social.ts. Migration 20261108000000_hangouts.sql. Tests: tests/db/hangouts.test.ts, tests/ui/hangouts.test.tsx, src/lib/__tests__/hangouts.test.ts.

Friends who are around#

Home's Instant Hangouts card and Your people list show friends who are online now, online first, with their status and — when you can see that channel yourself — the voice channel they're in. Data comes from friends_activity(): accepted, unblocked friends with a device heartbeat in the last 2 minutes, polled once a minute while the tab is visible (useFriendsActivity).

  • Invisible friends never appear.
  • Settings → Privacy → Show friends when I'm around (privacy_settings.share_activity) hides you from everyone's feed.
  • A voice channel is only revealed if can_view_channel is true for the viewer, so private channels and Tambayans you're not in stay private.

Moments#

What. Optional 24-hour updates on Home — text and/or one photo — for all friends or favourites only. How. Home → Moments → post; view, mute a person, report or delete your own. Limits. 10 live moments per person; photos ≤ 5 MB in the private moments bucket. Permissions. Viewers must be friends (and a favourite of the author for favourites-only); muted authors are hidden; expired moments disappear for viewers immediately while the author can still see and delete them. Reports go to the Control Center's Reports tab. Retention. Rows are purged by the platform job a day after expiry; the photo of a purged moment stays in Storage until the author deletes their account (documented shortcut). Code: Moments.tsx. Tests: tests/db/moments.test.ts, tests/ui/moments.test.tsx.

Known limitations#

  • No read-receipt or typing-indicator opt-out.
  • Hangouts have no shared notes or task boards (the Tambayan workspace has them) and no files while temporary.
  • "Around now" is heartbeat-based (up to ~2 minutes behind) and per device, not per tab.
  • No message requests from non-friends; DMs are friends-only by design.
  • Group DMs have no roles, ownership transfer UI or custom icons.
  • Moments have no reactions or replies.

features/communities.title: Tambayans (communities)
features/communities.description: A Tambayan is a server: members, channels in categories, ranks and roles, and community tools.
features/communities.html:
A Tambayan is a server: members, channels in categories, ranks and roles, and community tools.

Main code: actions/servers.ts, ServerProvider, ChannelSidebar, MemberList, ServerSettingsDialog and components/server/settings/, lib/servers.ts, lib/data/servers.ts. Routes: /tambayan/[serverId]/[channelId], /tambayan/[serverId]/lfg, /tambayan/[serverId]/workspace, /tambayan/explore, /invite/[code].

Creating and joining#

Action How Rules
Create Server rail → Add a server → name, description, template Templates: Gaming crew, Study group, Creator community, Friend group, Organization / team. Every template has general chat and voice; study/creator/team add resource and discussion channels. You become owner and admin
Join by invite Open /invite/<code> or paste a link/code in Add a server Refused when banned (BANNED) or already in 100 Tambayans (SERVER_JOIN_LIMIT)
Join from Explore /tambayan/explore → browse by category or search → Join Only servers whose admins listed them (is_public); same ban and limit checks (join_public_server)
Leave Server context menu → Leave Owners must transfer ownership or delete the server first
Transfer / delete Server settings → Overview (owner) Deleting removes channels and messages

Everyone is also a member of Diskarte HQ, the system Tambayan (no owner; can't be deleted).

Discovery categories: Gaming, Study, Creators, Friends, Music, Tech, Anime, Sports, Other. Nothing about unlisted servers is ever returned (discover_servers).

Templates and export: Server settings → Overview (admins) also holds rules, welcome messages and levels, and can export the server's settings as JSON (export_server_settings).

Tests: tests/db/invites.test.ts, tests/db/discovery.test.ts, tests/db/templates.test.ts, tests/db/super-server.test.ts, tests/ui/explore-messages.test.tsx.

Channels#

Type Purpose
Text Chat; name a–z 0–9 _ -, ≤ 32 chars
Voice LiveKit room voice:<id>; any name ≤ 32 chars
Forum Titled posts with threads

Moderators create, edit, reorder (drag or keyboard) and delete channels and set per-channel topic, category, slow mode, read-only (moderators post) and verified accounts only. Only admins make a channel private or public again. Channel mutes and "hide muted channels" are per browser. The last channel you opened in each server is remembered so the rail links straight to it.

Ranks, roles and permissions#

Rank Can
Member Read and post where allowed, react, join voice, create invites, RSVP, post LFG beacons
Moderator + pin, delete others' messages, slow mode/verification/read-only, kick, ban, timeout, warn members below them, voice moderation, see the audit log, bans and all invites, schedule events, create channels
Admin + server settings (overview, roles, auto-mod, emoji, soundboard, webhooks, announcements, support), change ranks, private channels, levels reset
Owner + demote admins, transfer ownership, delete the server

Rules are enforced by RLS and guard triggers (see database.md → Permission model); the UI mirrors them with canManageMember() only to hide controls you can't use.

Custom roles (Server settings → Roles): named, coloured labels (nine readable colours) handed out from a member's right-click menu. They show as role colours (toggle in Settings → Accessibility) and can be mentioned by moderators with @{Role name}. They grant no moderation power; their main use is private channel access: a private channel is visible to admins plus the members and roles it was opened to (channel_access).

Tests: tests/db/private-channels.test.ts, tests/db/ownership.test.ts, tests/ui/roles-private.test.tsx.

Invites#

  • Every server has a permanent invite code (admins can regenerate it).
  • Any member can create extra links that expire after 30 min, 1 h, 6 h, 12 h, 1 day, 7 days or never, with 1, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100 or unlimited uses. Using a limited invite consumes a use (rejoining as a member doesn't).
  • Moderators see and revoke every invite; members see and revoke their own (Server settings → Invites).
  • /invite/<code> previews the server (get_invite) before joining.

Membership screening#

What. Joining questions (up to 5, 200 characters each) and/or moderator approval for new members. How. Server settings → Membership (admins set it up; moderators see the queue). While either is on, joining by invite or from Explore opens a Before you join form with the rules and questions instead of joining straight away.

Setting What joining does
Questions only Answer them and you join immediately; the answers are kept
Approval on A pending request (join_requests) that moderators Approve (adds the member) or Decline
  • join_server raises SCREENING_REQUIRED; the form reads join_screening(code | server), which only returns the name, rules, questions and your own request status — and only for a live invite code or a server listed in Explore.
  • request_to_join validates one 1–500 character answer per question (INVALID_ANSWERS), counts a limited invite's use, caps you at 10 pending requests, and makes a declined applicant wait a day (JOIN_REQUEST_REJECTED).
  • decide_join_request is moderators-only, refuses banned users and writes member.approve / member.reject to the audit log. Moderators watch the queue live on db:join-requests:<server> and get a "N people want to join" nudge in the channel sidebar.
  • Applicants see only their own requests; other members never see applications. Answers are in the applicant's data export.

Code: JoinScreening.tsx. Migration 20261108010000_membership_screening.sql. Tests: tests/db/membership-screening.test.ts, tests/ui/join-screening.test.tsx.

Server rules#

Admins write rules (Server settings → Overview). Members must accept the current rules before posting; editing the rules asks everyone again (rules_updated_at). Moderators and up are exempt. RulesGate shows a card instead of the composer until accepted; the database refuses posts with RULES_NOT_ACCEPTED. Tests: tests/db/server-rules.test.ts, tests/ui/rules-gate.test.tsx.

Welcome messages#

Admins pick a text channel and a template; when someone joins, Diskarte posts it there as "Welcome" (like a webhook post), replacing {user} with @username and {server} with the server name. A failed post never blocks the join. Tests: tests/db/welcome-messages.test.ts.

Recurring announcements#

Server settings → Announcements: post a message in a text channel every day, or weekly on one weekday, at a local time in the admin's time zone (up to 10 per server). The minute platform job posts due ones as "Announcement" and shows the last run or error in the list. Requires the platform cron job (background jobs). Tests: tests/db/recurring-announcements.test.ts, tests/ui/server-automation-settings.test.tsx.

Events#

What. Scheduled events in a voice channel or elsewhere, with Interested RSVPs. How. Sidebar Events row (shows a count or LIVE) → browse, RSVP, or (moderators) schedule. Behaviour.

  • Optional capacity 1–10,000; RSVP counts update atomically on the event row, so events can't be overbooked; list_server_events returns canonical counts and your own RSVP.
  • Repeat: one event or a weekly series of 4, 8 or 12 separate occurrences (created in your device's time zone; edit or cancel each one afterwards).
  • Moderators edit with concurrent-change detection and confirm cancellation.
  • Add to calendar: RFC 5545 .ics export with UTC times.
  • Events in a private channel (and their attendee lists) are only visible to people who can see that channel.
  • An event without an end time counts as over 4 hours after it starts.
  • With Web Push configured, people who are Interested get a reminder 15 minutes before.

Tests: tests/db/events.test.ts, tests/db/event-capacity.test.ts, tests/ui/events.test.tsx, src/lib/__tests__/events.test.ts, e2e/events.spec.ts.

Community levels#

Off by default; admins enable them per Tambayan. Members earn 15 XP per message at most once a minute; level = ⌊√(XP / 50)⌋. A sidebar Leaderboard shows the top members; levels appear on member profiles. Turning levels off hides them and stops earning but keeps XP; admins can reset XP for a new season (reset_server_xp). Tests: tests/db/community-levels.test.ts, tests/ui/levels.test.tsx.

Custom emoji#

Admins upload up to 50 PNG/GIF/WebP images (≤ 256 KB) with a :name: usable in messages and reactions in that server (public emoji bucket). Tests: tests/db/emoji.test.ts, tests/ui/emoji.test.tsx.

Soundboard#

12 built-in synthesized 8-bit clips plus up to 24 uploaded MP3s per server (≤ 1 MB, checked for MP3 magic bytes, played for at most 6 s). Played to everyone in the call over the LiveKit data channel; one clip per person every 2 s; anyone can mute the soundboard for themselves.

Support and badges#

Server settings → Support: GCash/Maya numbers and a thank-you note shown in the Support this server dialog. Admins grant Server Booster, Lodi Supporter and GCash Contributor badges, shown in the member list and on profile cards. Boost levels unlock at 2, 7 and 14 boosters (cosmetic only). Diskarte doesn't process payments.

LFG board#

/tambayan/[serverId]/lfg: post a beacon (game, party size, voice channel, expiry). Join Party adds you (row-locked capacity check in join_lfg) and drops you into the voice channel. Beacons update live over db:lfg:<server>.

Incoming webhooks#

Server settings → Webhooks (admins): create a secret URL for a text channel; any HTTP client can post plain messages with {"content": "…", "username": "…"}. The token is shown once and stored hashed; rotate it if it leaks. Webhook posts can't ping @everyone/@here, are limited to 30 per minute per webhook; creating and rotating webhooks is audited. Full API: API reference. Tests: tests/db/channel-webhooks.test.ts, src/app/api/webhooks/[id]/[token]/__tests__/.

Suggestion boards#

A forum channel can be switched to a suggestion board (forum ⚙ → Forum settings, moderators): members post ideas and upvote them (one vote each; 30 votes a minute), and moderators set a status — Under consideration, Planned, In progress, Completed or Declined. Filter by status or tag and sort by Top. See Forum channels for tags and Solved posts.

Known limitations#

  • No outgoing webhooks, bot users, slash-command apps or a general automation builder.
  • Custom roles carry no permissions other than private-channel access.
  • No server folders, vanity URLs or member screening questions.
  • Badges and boosts are cosmetic; payments happen outside Diskarte.

features/moderation.title: Moderation and administration
features/moderation.description: Two levels: Bantay-Bayan tools inside each Tambayan (for its moderators and admins), and the Super Admin Control Center for the whole platform.
features/moderation.html:
Two levels: Bantay-Bayan tools inside each Tambayan (for its moderators and admins), and the Super Admin Control Center for the whole platform.

Bantay-Bayan (per Tambayan)#

Main code: actions/moderation.ts, actions/voice.ts, settings panels in components/server/settings/, PersonMenu (right-click on a member). Tables: audit_logs, server_bans, member_warnings, members.timeout_until, servers.automod_*, channels.slowmode_seconds/requires_verification/read_only.

Auto-mod#

Server settings → Bantay-Bayan (admins): a master switch, built-in categories and custom blocked words. Runs inside the database on every message insert (messages_before_insert_community → automod_match), so it can't be bypassed.

Category Catches
Spam & flooding Repeated messages (the same text 3 times in a minute), mass mentions, "free nitro" and get-rich-quick scams
Phishing links Fake GCash/Maya/bank/Discord/Steam links, IP loggers, lookalike (punycode) domains
Hate speech Slurs targeting race, gender and disability
Explicit content Porn sites and sexual terms (English and Tagalog)
Custom words Admin's list, matched after leetspeak normalisation

Moderators are exempt. A blocked message is dropped silently (the insert returns no row) and an automod.block entry with a 200-character excerpt is written to the audit log; raising an error would roll the audit entry back. Phishing links are also refused in DMs.

Channel controls#

Control Options Who
Slow mode Off, 5 s, 10 s, 30 s, 1 m, 5 m, 15 m, 1 h, 6 h Moderators set; moderators exempt
Read-only Only moderators post Moderators
Verified accounts only Confirmed email/phone needed to post Moderators
Private Visible to admins + granted members/roles Admins only

Member actions#

All require outranking the target (the owner outranks everyone; admins and the owner can't be timed out).

Action Effect Audit action
Timeout 60 s, 5 min, 10 min, 1 h, 1 day or 1 week: can read but not send, react or join voice member.timeout, member.timeout_remove
Warn A note shown to the member once (WarningNotice, live); moderators see the history member.warn
Kick Removes membership member.kick
Ban (with reason) Removes membership and refuses rejoining via any invite or Explore member.ban, member.unban
Change rank Admins only; owner-only for demoting admins member.role_update
Server nickname Self, or moderators for lower ranks —

Voice moderation#

Right-click someone in a voice channel: Server Mute / Unmute, Server Deafen / Undeafen, Disconnect, Move to another (non-private) voice channel. Implemented through LiveKit's server API; see architecture.

Audit log#

Server settings → Audit log (moderators and up). Written only by definer functions/triggers (log_audit() isn't callable by clients). Recorded actions:

member.join, member.leave, member.kick, member.ban, member.unban, member.timeout, member.timeout_remove, member.warn, member.role_update, message.delete (with excerpt), automod.block, channel.create, channel.update, channel.delete, server.update, server.transfer, invite.regenerate, badge.grant, badge.revoke, soundboard.add, soundboard.remove, lfg.close, webhook.create, webhook.rotate, workspace.create, workspace.delete.

Tests: tests/db/community.test.ts, tests/db/timeouts.test.ts, tests/db/security.test.ts, tests/community/actions.test.ts, e2e/community.spec.ts.

Problem reports#

Anyone signed in can use Settings → Report a problem (categories: something's broken, it's slow or laggy, account or sign-in, something else). The current page and browser are attached. The database allows 5 reports per hour per person. Reporters see their own reports; super admins triage them in the Control Center (open → escalated / resolved / dismissed, with an optional issue link). Moments reports land in the same tab. Triage is manual — the automated issue/agent workflow that earlier versions mentioned was removed. Tests: tests/db/problem-reports.test.ts, tests/components/ReportProblemForm.test.tsx.

Super Admin Control Center#

Access. /admin (and /tambayan/admin on phones) for platform super_admins only. Checked by the proxy (is_super_admin() before rendering), the page, every Server Action and every admin_* RPC; the Control Center code is only downloaded by super admins. On tablets and up it opens as a panel in the workspace; on phones it's a full page.

Main code: components/admin/, actions/admin.ts, /api/admin/snapshot, 20261006000000_admin_control_center.sql.

Tab What it shows / does
Network Every account with live presence, LiveKit connection, devices (hashed fingerprint + label), sessions and last activity; instant filters and server-side search by username, display name or email. The user inspector changes platform role, overrides status, revokes sessions, bans/unbans
Traffic Unique browsers per Manila day from site_visits (no IPs or user ids)
Voice Live LiveKit rooms across the network, who is connected, mic state, call length
Broadcast The Global Announcement Dispatcher: Markdown with headers, callouts (> [!INFO], [!SUCCESS], [!WARNING], [!CRITICAL]) and code blocks, preview, post to Diskarte HQ #announcements and/or #global-lounge; optionally sticky (a banner on every canvas for N hours); retract
Reports Problem reports triage
Audit admin_audit_logs: every role change, status override, revocation, ban and broadcast

Platform roles. super_admin or moderator in platform_admins (no row = standard member), mirrored into Diskarte HQ as admin/moderator. The first super admin is granted with npm run admin:grant; afterwards roles change only in the Control Center, and nobody can change their own role.

Platform bans and revocations. A ban sets auth.users.banned_until, deletes the account's sessions and is enforced by restrictive RLS on messages and DMs; open canvases sign out within seconds. Super admins can't ban themselves or other super admins.

Tests: tests/db/admin-control-center.test.ts, tests/admin/*.test.ts(x), tests/auth/account-gates.test.ts, e2e/admin.spec.ts.

Known limitations#

  • No message reporting inside Tambayans (only Moments and problem reports); moderators act on what they see.
  • No automated or AI moderation beyond the rule-based auto-mod.
  • Audit logs are not exported or retained on a schedule; they are kept indefinitely.
  • No appeal workflow for bans.

features/voice-and-video.description: User-facing behaviour. The token flow, room lifecycle, recovery and moderation internals are in Voice, video and screen sharing.

User-facing behaviour. The token flow, room lifecycle, recovery and moderation internals are in Voice, video and screen sharing.

Main code: CallProvider, VoiceChannelView, VoiceStage, VoiceControls, CallDock, IncomingCalls.

Joining and leaving#

Where How
Voice channel Open it: a lobby shows who's inside; Join connects. Hovering/focusing the channel pre-loads the call so joining is quick
DM or group DM Call button: rings everyone else for 45 s
"Ring to voice" Ping one member into the voice channel you're in
LFG Join Party drops you into the beacon's voice channel

While connected, the Voice Connected dock above your user panel shows where you are, the mixer and Disconnect; on phones a persistent call strip does the same. The call keeps running while you browse other channels, servers, DMs and Settings. If the page reloads (including after an app update), the call rejoins automatically within 30 seconds, keeping mute/deafen.

In a call#

Control Notes
Mute / deafen User panel and call controls
Camera 720p normally, 360p in low-data mode
Screen share 1080p at 15 fps (720p at 5 fps in low-data mode), with optional tab/system audio; focus mode goes full screen (fixed overlay on iOS). Only one shared screen is downloaded at a time — pick which to watch
Noise suppression / input profile Isolation, Studio or Custom (Settings → Voice & Video)
Push to talk Hold a chosen key to talk; never triggered while typing
Mixer Master volume, per-person volume, separate screen-share audio volume, local mute and "Disable Video"; remembered on this device
Devices Switch microphone/speakers mid-call; Mic Test in settings
Connection meter 8-bit signal bars with latency, packet loss, jitter and LiveKit's quality rating
Speaking indicators A stable ring around whoever is talking, also visible to people browsing the server sidebar
Soundboard Built-in 8-bit sounds and the server's MP3 clips, heard by everyone (2 s cooldown, 6 s max)
Activities YouTube watch party (privacy-enhanced embed, synced play/pause/seek), Tic-Tac-Toe, Pinoy Trivia

Layout: an adaptive grid picks the column count that makes 16:9 tiles as large as possible (lib/voice-layout.ts); a screen share switches to a focus layout.

Voice activity previews#

Hover a Tambayan icon (or focus it and press Right Arrow; long-press → Voice activity on touch) to see who is in each voice channel — up to 8 avatars per channel, mute and streaming state — without joining. Selecting a channel opens it; it never joins automatically.

Permissions#

  • Voice channels: members of the Tambayan who can see the channel and aren't timed out.
  • DM calls: participants of the conversation.
  • Rings: DM participants or fellow members; never across a block.
  • Moderators can server-mute, deafen, disconnect and move members below them.

Errors and recovery#

Message Meaning
"Couldn't connect to voice. Try again." Token request failed (network)
"You're timed out in this server" Moderator timeout
"Voice is not configured on this server" The deployment lacks LiveKit credentials
"Too many voice join attempts" 20 joins per minute
Browser permission prompt denied Allow microphone/camera in site settings (HTTPS or localhost only)
"Click to turn on sound" Autoplay was blocked after a rejoin

Tests#

src/components/voice/__tests__/voice.test.tsx, screen-watch.test.tsx, stream-volume.test.tsx, src/app/api/livekit/token/__tests__/, src/app/api/livekit/webhook/__tests__/, src/app/api/voice-preview/__tests__/, tests/ui/IncomingCalls.test.tsx, tests/ui/VoiceActivity.test.tsx, tests/ui/voice-preview.test.tsx, tests/ui/voice-settings.test.tsx, tests/db/rings.test.ts, tests/community/watch-party.test.tsx, tests/community/trivia-game.test.tsx, e2e/voice.spec.ts.

Known limitations#

  • No recording, transcription, stage/presenter mode, noise gate per participant or E2E encryption.
  • Web Push call alerts don't ring a locked phone like a native call.
  • Not tested on physical phones or with Bluetooth headsets.
  • Can't move members into private voice channels.

features/workspace.title: Shared workspace
features/workspace.description: Each text channel can hold shared documents that members edit together: notes, task boards and focus timers, plus one resource list and one whiteboard per channel.
features/workspace.html:
Each text channel can hold shared documents that members edit together: notes, task boards and focus timers, plus one resource list and one whiteboard per channel.

Where. /tambayan/[serverId]/workspace — a document library with a type filter; editors open full screen on phones. Code: SharedWorkspaceView, WorkspaceAsset, actions/workspace.ts, lib/workspace-documents.ts, lib/workspace-assets.ts. Tables: workspace_documents (notes, boards, focus), workspace_assets (resources, whiteboard), both in the Realtime publication.

Document types and limits#

Type Content Limits (validated by Zod and again in SQL)
Note Markdown text Title 1–100 chars; text ≤ 20,000 chars; whole payload ≤ 64 KB
Task board Cards with a title and a status: To do / Doing / Done ≤ 200 cards, unique ids, titles 1–160 chars
Focus timer Goal and duration; a shared countdown Goal ≤ 200 chars; 1–120 whole minutes; endsAt set from the database clock so every member sees the same end time
Resources Links with title and description ≤ 30 items, https:// URLs only
Whiteboard Freehand strokes on a 1200-unit canvas ≤ 100 strokes, ≤ 2,500 points total, 5 colours, widths 1–12

Permissions#

Reading follows the channel: if you can see the channel (can_view_channel, including private-channel grants) you can see its workspace. Editing (can_edit_workspace) additionally requires:

  • a completed two-factor session and no platform ban;
  • not being timed out in that Tambayan;
  • for read-only channels, being an admin; for verification-only channels, being verified or a moderator.

Creating and deleting documents is recorded in the audit log (workspace.create, workspace.delete).

Concurrent editing#

Documents are not co-edited keystroke by keystroke. Each save sends the revision it was based on; save_workspace_document / save_workspace_asset only succeed if that is still the latest revision and then increment it. On a conflict:

  1. The editor keeps your local changes (nothing is overwritten).
  2. It shows the latest saved version.
  3. You explicitly choose to keep yours against the new revision (then save again) or take theirs.

Other members' saves arrive live over Realtime. Leaving an editor with unsaved changes asks for confirmation. Losing access while editing shows a permission state instead of failing silently.

Errors and recovery#

workspaceLoadIssue() distinguishes four states so the UI can say what's wrong: setup (migration missing — run npm run db:check), session (signed out/MFA), permission and connection.

Tests#

tests/db/workspace.test.ts, tests/db/workspace-assets.test.ts, tests/ui/shared-workspace.test.tsx, tests/ui/workspace-assets.test.tsx, src/lib/__tests__/workspace-load.test.ts, e2e/sync-workspace.spec.ts.

Known limitations#

  • No real-time co-editing (CRDT/OT), cursors or comments; conflicts are resolved explicitly.
  • One resource list and one whiteboard per channel; no images on the whiteboard.
  • No document history beyond the current revision, and no export.

Report a problem Problem report form problem_reports

Per-server notification level (@mentions only / nothing) and server mute live in each server's menu; channel mutes in the channel's menu.

Account security#

  • Password: change in My Account (accounts that sign in with email), with the live policy checklist. Recovery via "Forgot password".
  • Two-factor (TOTP): enrol with any authenticator app; once on, new sessions must enter a code at /mfa, and the database refuses unverified sessions. See Authentication and security.
  • Sign out everywhere revokes every refresh token.

Data export#

Storage & Data → Request all of my data downloads one JSON document (export_my_data) with your profile, Tambayans, messages, DMs, reactions, friends, blocks, notes, nicknames, favourites, saved messages, poll votes, RSVPs, warnings received, LFG posts, problem reports, scheduled messages, moments, XP and settings. Other people's content beyond who you're connected to isn't included. Tests: tests/db/export.test.ts, tests/db/account-data-coverage.test.ts.

Account deletion#

My Account → Danger zone → type your username. Your uploaded files are deleted first, then the account: Tambayans you own pass to their highest-ranked, longest-standing member (or are deleted if you're alone), your messages with attachments are deleted, other messages remain without an author, and private data is removed. Requires a completed two-factor session if 2FA is on. Irreversible. Tests: tests/db/account.test.ts, tests/account/delete-account.test.ts.

Low-data mode#

Smaller and lower-quality images (quality 40), GIFs don't autoplay, videos don't preload, cameras capture at 360p, screen shares at 720p/5 fps, and remote video uses low simulcast layers. Defaults to the browser's Save-Data hint until you choose. lib/low-data.ts.

Installable app (PWA)#

Install from the browser menu (Android/desktop) or Share → Add to Home Screen (iOS). The installed app opens at /tambayan, has Messages and Explore shortcuts, follows your colour mode in the status bar, and supports Web Push (iOS 16.4+ only when installed). Offline you get an offline page and your unsent messages queue; past conversations aren't available offline. See Notifications, service worker and PWA.

Sound effects#

All cues are synthesized 8-bit sounds (no audio files): join, leave, mute, unmute, deafen, message, mention, send, error, start, ring. Settings → Notifications → sounds, or the speaker button in the user panel, sets the master volume.

Tests#

tests/ui/SettingsDialog.test.tsx, tests/ui/two-factor.test.tsx, tests/db/mfa.test.ts, tests/db/account-state.test.ts, src/hooks/__tests__/account-sync.test.tsx, src/lib/__tests__/display-prefs.test.ts, src/lib/__tests__/locale.test.ts, e2e/appearance.spec.ts, e2e/pwa.spec.ts.

Known limitations#

  • Most preferences are per browser and don't follow you to another device (drafts and notification preferences do).
  • Filipino covers core navigation and settings only; most UI text is English.
  • No passkeys/WebAuthn, SMS 2FA or recovery codes; losing the authenticator needs an admin.
  • No in-app email change.
