help/faq.description: Yes. Diskarte is open source and can run on free tiers of its hosting services. There are no paid plans inside the app; Tambayan "support" badges and GCash/Maya numbers are just for communities that w

headings.text: Do I need to download an app?
How many Tambayans can I join?
Can I edit or delete a message?
Why did my message disappear right after I sent it?
Does Diskarte work on slow or prepaid connections?
Can I use Diskarte in Filipino?
How do I get my data or delete my account?

help/faq.html:
Is Diskarte free?#

Yes. Diskarte is open source and can run on free tiers of its hosting services. There are no paid plans inside the app; Tambayan "support" badges and GCash/Maya numbers are just for communities that want to thank their supporters, and payments happen outside Diskarte.

Do I need to download an app?#

No. Diskarte works in your browser. You can also install it to your home screen like an app — see Create an account and install.

Who can message me?#

Only your friends can start a DM with you. You choose who can send you friend requests in Settings → Privacy & Safety: everyone, only people who share a Tambayan with you, or nobody. Block someone to stop them contacting you completely.

Who can see my messages?#

  • Messages in a Tambayan channel: members of that Tambayan (and, for a private channel, only the people and roles allowed in it).
  • DMs: only the people in that conversation.
  • Moments: your friends, or only your favourites if you choose.

Messages are protected in transit and by access rules on the server. They are not end-to-end encrypted.

How many Tambayans can I join?#

Up to 100.

Can I edit or delete a message?#

Yes, your own. Hover (or long-press) the message and choose Edit or Delete. Edited messages show "(edited)"; you and the Tambayan's moderators can see earlier versions.

Why did my message disappear right after I sent it?#

The Tambayan's auto-moderation probably blocked it (spam, a suspicious link or a blocked word). Ask a moderator if you think it was a mistake.

Does Diskarte work on slow or prepaid connections?#

Yes. Turn on Low-data mode in Settings → Storage & Data. Messages you send while offline wait in a queue and go out when you reconnect. See Connection problems.

Can I use Diskarte in Filipino?#

The main menus and settings can be shown in Filipino: Settings → Language & Region. Most other text is in English for now.

How do I get my data or delete my account?#

Settings → Storage & Data → Request all of my data downloads everything your account wrote or set. Settings → My Account → Danger zone deletes your account permanently. See Notifications, privacy and safety.

Something isn't covered here#

Browse the user guides, check Known issues, or report a problem.

help/connection.title: Connection problems
help/connection.description: Diskarte reconnects on its own and fetches anything you missed. If a chat still looks stale:

headings.text: Using a weak or expensive connection

help/connection.html:
Messages won't send#

What you see What to do
An 8-bit offline bar and messages marked as waiting You're offline. Keep going — waiting messages send automatically, in order, when you reconnect
A message marked as failed with Retry Tap Retry. Retrying never creates a duplicate
"Slow down — you're sending too fast" Wait a few seconds
"Slow mode — you can send again in …" The channel limits how often people post

Messages from others stop appearing#

Diskarte reconnects on its own and fetches anything you missed. If a chat still looks stale:

  1. Use Retry sync if it appears in the chat.
  2. Check that you're still a member of the Tambayan (you may have been removed or a channel made private).
  3. Reload the page.

Settings → Advanced → Connection diagnostics lists recent connection events on this device (no message content), which helps when you report a problem.

Voice or video problems#

Problem Try
"Couldn't connect to voice" Check your connection and press Join again
The browser blocked your microphone or camera Allow them in the site settings (the lock icon in the address bar). Diskarte only works with media over HTTPS
Others can't hear you Check Settings → Voice & Video for the right microphone and use Mic Test; make sure you aren't muted or using push to talk
You can't hear anyone Check you aren't deafened, the mixer volume, and your output device. After a page reload, press turn on sound if it appears
Choppy audio or video Turn your camera off, or turn on Low-data mode. The signal bars show latency and packet loss
"You're timed out in this server" A moderator timed you out; it ends on its own
Dropped after the page reloaded Diskarte rejoins the call automatically within 30 seconds

Using a weak or expensive connection#

  • Low-data mode (Settings → Storage & Data) loads smaller images, stops GIF autoplay and uses lower video quality.
  • Audio-only calls use very little data.
  • Installed Diskarte keeps its app files on your device, so it opens faster on slow networks.

Still stuck?#

Report a problem and mention what you were doing and roughly when.

help/notifications.title: Notification issues

headings.text: I get notified about something I already read

help/notifications.html:
I don't get any notifications#

Work through these in order:

  1. Is the Tambayan or channel muted? Open the Tambayan's menu → Notification Settings, and check whether a channel shows as muted.
  2. Quiet hours or a pause? Settings → Notifications: quiet hours and Pause for 1 hour silence sounds, rings and alerts.
  3. Browser permission. If you blocked notifications for Diskarte, allow them again in the browser's site settings, then turn them back on in Diskarte.
  4. Push for this device. To get alerts while Diskarte is closed, turn on This device in Settings → Notifications and pick the kinds you want. If it says push isn't set up, the Diskarte server you use hasn't enabled background notifications yet.
  5. Your phone's settings. Focus modes, Do Not Disturb and battery savers can delay or hide notifications.

iPhone and iPad#

Notifications only work when Diskarte is installed to the Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or newer):

  1. Open Diskarte in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen.
  2. Open Diskarte from the Home Screen icon.
  3. Settings → Notifications → turn on This device and allow notifications when asked.

Notifications only say "Diskarte"#

That's the private default: the lock screen doesn't show who wrote or what. Turn on previews in Settings → Notifications if you want them.

I get notified about something I already read#

Read state syncs across devices, so this should be rare. If a device was closed while you read elsewhere, its badge can stay until it next receives something or you open it.

Too many notifications#

  • Set busy Tambayans to Only @mentions or Nothing.
  • Mute Channel on noisy channels.
  • Turn off categories you don't need under This device.
  • Use quiet hours at night.

See also Notifications, privacy and safety.

help/sign-in.description: Fixes for passwords, two-factor codes, expired links and sign-in errors.

headings.text: The confirmation or reset link doesn't work
I'm asked for a code after my password
I'm sent to "New password" every time I sign in

help/sign-in.html:
Fixes for passwords, two-factor codes, expired links and sign-in errors.

I forgot my password#

  1. On the sign-in page choose Forgot your password?.
  2. Enter your email. For privacy, Diskarte always says it sent a link, whether or not that email has an account.
  3. Open the link in the email (check Spam) and choose a new password: at least 10 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.

"Too many requests"#

You tried to sign in several times in a minute. Wait a minute and try again.

The confirmation or reset link doesn't work#

Links work once and expire. Request a new one. If you opened it on a different device or browser, that's fine — but use the newest link.

I'm asked for a code after my password#

You turned on two-factor sign-in. Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for Diskarte. If you lost access to your authenticator, contact the people who run your Diskarte server; they can remove two-factor from your account after confirming it's you.

"Your session ended"#

You were signed out — for example after "sign out everywhere", a password change elsewhere, or an account action by an administrator. Sign in again.

I'm sent to "New password" every time I sign in#

Your account was created with a temporary password. Choose your own password once and you'll go straight in afterwards.

Sign-up says registrations are paused#

This Diskarte server only accepts invited members at the moment.

Google or GitHub sign-in fails#

Try again, or sign in with email and password if you set one. If the button is missing, that sign-in method isn't enabled on this server.

Keep your account safe#

Use a unique password, turn on two-factor sign-in, and use Settings → Devices & Sessions → sign out everywhere after using a shared computer.

help/mobile-app.description: Diskarte installs from the browser as a progressive web app — no app store.

headings.text: The app looks out of date
The keyboard covers the message box
Calls stop when I switch apps

help/mobile-app.html:
Diskarte installs from the browser as a progressive web app — no app store.

I can't find "Install"#

Device Where
iPhone / iPad Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen (other iOS browsers may not offer it)
Android Chrome → ⋮ → Install app or Add to Home screen
Computer The install icon in Chrome or Edge's address bar, or Settings → Storage & Data → Install Diskarte

The app looks out of date#

Open Settings → Storage & Data. If an update is ready, press Reload to update (finish any call first). Your drafts and unsent messages are kept.

The app is acting strangely#

Settings → Storage & Data → Clear downloaded app files removes the cached app files and downloads fresh ones. Drafts and waiting messages stay.

The keyboard covers the message box#

Diskarte resizes itself when the on-screen keyboard opens. If something still looks off, rotate the phone or close and reopen the keyboard; then report it with your phone model.

No notifications on iPhone#

Notifications need the Home Screen app on iOS 16.4 or newer. See Notification issues.

Calls stop when I switch apps#

Phones may pause audio for web apps in the background, depending on the browser and battery settings. Keep Diskarte open during important calls.

I'm offline#

You'll see an offline page if you open Diskarte without a connection, and messages you send wait until you're back online. Conversations you haven't loaded aren't available offline.

help/report-a-problem.title: Report a problem
help/report-a-problem.html:
In Diskarte (signed in)#

Settings → Report a problem:

  1. Choose what kind of problem it is: something's broken, it's slow or laggy, account or sign-in, or something else.
  2. Describe what you were doing, what you expected and what happened (at least 10 characters).
  3. Send. The page you were on and your browser type are attached so the team can reproduce it.

The Diskarte team reviews every report. You can send up to five reports an hour.

Don't include passwords, codes or private conversations in a report.

Problems with these docs#

Use Suggest an improvement at the bottom of any docs page. When you're signed in it goes to the same review queue; otherwise it opens a prefilled issue on GitHub.

Security issues#

Please report vulnerabilities privately, not in a public issue — see the project's security policy.

Inappropriate content or people#

  • In a Tambayan, tell its moderators; they can delete messages, time out, warn, kick or ban.
  • Block anyone who bothers you.
  • Report a Moment from its options menu.

Before you report#

Check Known issues and the other help pages — your problem may already have a fix.

help/privacy.title: Privacy and your data
help/privacy.description: What Diskarte stores, who can see it, and how to get it or delete it — in plain language. This page describes how the software and the official instance work today; it is not a legal agreement. Diskar
help/privacy.html:
What Diskarte stores, who can see it, and how to get it or delete it — in plain language. This page describes how the software and the official instance work today; it is not a legal agreement. Diskarte is open source, so anyone can run their own server: a self-hosted Diskarte is run by its own operators, who decide their own policies.

What we store#

Data Why Who can see it
Email, username, display name, password To sign you in. Passwords are stored as one-way hashes by the sign-in service You. Platform administrators can see your email
Profile: avatar, banner, bio, status So people recognise you Anyone signed in
Messages, reactions, attachments, voice messages, polls The conversations you take part in Members of that Tambayan or channel; for DMs, only the people in the conversation
Moments Short updates for friends Your friends, or only your favourites; they disappear after 24 hours
Friends, blocks, nicknames, notes, favourites Your social settings Friend lists are visible to the two people involved; nicknames, notes, favourites and blocks only to you
Sessions and devices Security: you can sign out other devices; administrators can stop abuse You; platform administrators (a device label and a scrambled fingerprint, never raw browser details)
Problem reports To fix what's broken You and platform administrators; includes the page you were on and your browser type
Push notification registration To deliver notifications to a device you turned on Never shown to anyone; previews are off by default

What we don't do#

  • No ads, and no selling or sharing your data for advertising.
  • No AI features: your messages aren't analysed, summarised or used to train anything.
  • Voice and video calls aren't recorded. Audio and video travel through a media server (LiveKit) to the other people in the call; they are encrypted on the way, but not end-to-end.
  • Messages are protected by access rules on the server and encrypted in transit; they are not end-to-end encrypted, so the service operators could technically access them.

Services that handle your data#

Service What for
Supabase Database, sign-in, file storage and realtime updates
Vercel Runs the website and app; Vercel Web Analytics counts page views without cookies
LiveKit Cloud Relays voice, video and screen sharing
GIPHY GIF search (your search terms go to GIPHY through our server; GIFs you view load from GIPHY)
Your browser's push service (Apple, Google, Mozilla) Delivers notifications you turned on, as encrypted messages

Diskarte also counts visits itself: a random number stored in your browser is counted once per day, with no IP address or account attached. When you post a link, our server fetches the page to build the preview, so the linked site sees our server, not you.

Who else can see things#

  • Tambayan moderators and admins can see their Tambayan's audit log, which includes short excerpts of messages they delete, and moderation actions.
  • Platform administrators (the Diskarte team) can see account emails, sessions and devices, and can ban accounts or revoke sessions. Their actions are logged.

How long we keep it#

  • Messages, profiles and community data stay until you or a moderator delete them, or you delete your account.
  • Moments disappear for viewers after 24 hours and are removed from the database a day later. A removed Moment's photo currently stays in storage until you delete your account.
  • Notification delivery records are kept for 7 days.

Your choices#

  • Download your data: Settings → Storage & Data → Request all of my data.
  • Delete your account: Settings → My Account → Danger zone. Your files and private data are deleted; messages with attachments are deleted; other messages you sent remain without your name. Tambayans you own pass to their most senior member, or are deleted if nobody else is in them.
  • Control who reaches you: Settings → Privacy & Safety, blocking, and notification settings.
  • Turn off notification previews (they start off): Settings → Notifications.

Questions or concerns#

Report a problem from the app, or open an issue on the project's GitHub. Report security problems privately using the security policy.

help/known-issues.title: Known issues and limitations
help/known-issues.description: An honest list of what Diskarte doesn't do, what hasn't been verified, and what this documentation couldn't confirm. Keep it current: remove items when they're fixed, add them when found.
help/known-issues.html:
An honest list of what Diskarte doesn't do, what hasn't been verified, and what this documentation couldn't confirm. Keep it current: remove items when they're fixed, add them when found.

Product limitations#

Area Limitation
Offline Only an offline page and queued sends; conversations aren't readable offline
Messaging No message reporting inside Tambayans, translation, or scheduling in DMs; scheduled messages are text-only
Search simple text configuration — no stemming or language-aware matching
DMs Friends-only; no read-receipt or typing opt-out; group DMs have no roles or icons
Hangouts No shared notes/boards inside a hangout, no files while temporary; expired ones are deleted by the next purge (platform job or the next hangout anyone starts), but already stop accepting messages
Reminders Server messages only; shown while the app is open (no push)
Forums No post subscriptions or notifications for followed posts
Moments Photos of purged moments stay in Storage until the author deletes their account
Communities Custom roles grant only private-channel access; no outgoing webhooks, bot accounts, OAuth apps, interactive commands or general automation builder
Workspace No real-time co-editing, cursors, comments, history or export
Voice/video No recording, transcription, stage mode or E2E encryption; can't move members into private voice channels; push call alerts aren't native telephony
Accounts No passkeys, SMS 2FA, recovery codes or in-app email change
Localization Filipino covers core navigation, settings, the Home onboarding panels and in-app help links; most screens, notifications and the Help Center are English
Preferences Most display/voice/notification preferences are per browser, as are the Getting started dismissal and the What's New "seen" marker
Moderation Rule-based auto-mod only; no ban appeals; audit logs kept indefinitely
Native apps None; the PWA is the mobile app

Operational limitations#

Area Limitation
Rate limits In-memory per instance unless Upstash is configured; Server Action and route-level limits (messages, voice tokens, previews) are always per instance
Link previews Cache is per instance (1 hour, 500 entries)
Free tiers Render sleeps after ~15 min idle; Supabase pauses after a week idle
Background jobs Recurring announcements, the moments purge, the hangout purge (also run on demand) and offline status clearing need the pg_cron platform job
Migrations Applied manually; no automated drift detection beyond npm run db:check
Monitoring No alerting or uptime monitoring configured in the repository
Staging No staging environment defined in the repository

Not verified#

These were not verified by automated tests or during the writing of this documentation:

  • Physical devices: iOS/Android behaviour (keyboard, background audio, Bluetooth, battery policies, installed-PWA quirks) — all browser testing is Chromium emulation.
  • Safari and Firefox: no automated browser runs.
  • Web Push in production: VAPID/Vault configuration on the production project and delivery through Apple/Google/Mozilla push services.
  • LiveKit webhook in production: whether the production LiveKit project posts to /api/livekit/webhook.
  • Platform cron job state: whether enable-platform-jobs.sql is installed on the production project was not checked while writing these docs (select jobname, active from cron.job;).
  • Backups: no restore drill has been recorded.
  • Accessibility: axe-core automated checks only; no manual screen-reader audit.
  • Performance: no load testing; bundle and LCP numbers are one-off local measurements.

Documentation gaps#

  • Database function descriptions in the generated reference come from SQL comments; many functions have none. The hand-written database guide covers the important ones; add comments above create function in future migrations to fill the rest.
  • Historical docs (diskarte/DEPLOYMENT.md, diskarte/OPERATIONS.md, release notes) are kept for history and now point here; where they disagree with these docs, the code and these docs win. They still describe Render as the primary host and (in OPERATIONS.md) push as "not enabled in this release", which was true for October 14.
  • No license file. The README calls Diskarte open source, but the repository has no LICENSE file; only the Knewave font's OFL licence is included. The maintainers should choose and add one.
  • The problem_reports migration header mentions a .github/workflows/fix-agent.yml "autofix" workflow; that workflow and the automated report action were removed (manual triage only).
  • The Help Center has no interactive API console (copyable curl examples only), no per-version docs (it documents main), and no "was this helpful" counter — feedback is free text into the existing report queue or a GitHub issue.
  • Help Center screenshots come from the fixture harness and the production build with sample data; they are not captured on physical phones and show only English UI.

developers/local-setup.title: Local setup
developers/local-setup.description: Get Diskarte running locally, sign in and send a message in about ten minutes.
developers/local-setup.html:
Get Diskarte running locally, sign in and send a message in about ten minutes.

Requirements#

Tool Version Why
Node.js ≥ 20.9 (CI and Docker use 22) engines in package.json
npm bundled with Node The app has its own package-lock.json
A Supabase project hosted (free) or local via the Supabase CLI Database, auth, realtime, storage
A LiveKit server LiveKit Cloud (free) or a local dev server Voice/video (the rest of the app works without it)
Docker (optional) any recent Local Supabase (supabase start), local LiveKit, building the image
Chromium for Playwright (optional) npx playwright install chromium Browser tests

Supported browsers for using the app: current Chrome/Edge, Firefox and Safari. iOS needs 16.4+ for Web Push (installed to the Home Screen).

1. Install#

Terminal
git clone https://github.com/xndrncp08/Diskarte.git
cd Diskarte
npm install            # runs `npm ci` inside diskarte/

Or work directly in the app folder: cd diskarte && npm ci.

2. Choose a database#

Option A — hosted Supabase project (no Docker). Create a free project, then apply the migrations from the repository root:

Terminal
npx supabase link --project-ref <your-project-ref>
npx supabase db push

In the dashboard: Auth → URL configuration → add http://localhost:3000/auth/callback; Realtime → Settings → turn off "Allow public access". For quicker local sign-ups you can turn off email confirmation in a development project.

Option B — local Supabase (Docker).

Terminal
npx supabase start     # from the repository root; applies supabase/migrations
npx supabase status    # prints API URL (http://127.0.0.1:54321) and anon key

Local settings (supabase/config.toml): email confirmation off, the same password policy as production, a local mail catcher ([local_smtp]) on port 54324.

3. Configure#

Terminal
cp diskarte/.env.example diskarte/.env.local

Fill in at least:

Env
SUPABASE_URL=https://<ref>.supabase.co          # or http://127.0.0.1:54321
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=<anon or publishable key>
LIVEKIT_URL=wss://<project>.livekit.cloud       # or ws://localhost:7880
LIVEKIT_API_KEY=<key>                           # or devkey
LIVEKIT_API_SECRET=<secret>                     # or secret
SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000
AUTH_OAUTH_PROVIDERS=                           # empty = email/password only

For a local LiveKit dev server: docker compose --profile livekit up livekit (key devkey, secret secret). Every variable is described in the environment reference.

4. Run#

Terminal
npm run dev            # http://localhost:3000 (Turbopack)

If port 3000 is taken: npm run dev -- -p 3001 and set SITE_URL=http://localhost:3001, otherwise API POSTs fail the same-origin check.

5. First-run walkthrough#

  1. Open http://localhost:3000 → Sign up. Pick a username (3–32 lowercase letters, digits, _ or .) and a password with 10+ characters including upper, lower, digit and symbol.

  2. Confirm your email if your project requires it (local: no confirmation).

  3. Onboarding: choose a salakot avatar colour or upload a picture, add a bio and status.

  4. You land in /tambayan and are already a member of Diskarte HQ.

  5. Create your own Tambayan with Add a server (+) on the server rail, open #general and send a message.

  6. Open a second browser profile, sign up another account, and join with the invite link (server menu → Invite people) to see messages arrive live.

  7. Click a voice channel to join a call (allow microphone access).

  8. Make yourself a super admin to explore the Control Center:

    Terminal
    cd diskarte
SUPABASE_URL=… SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=… npm run admin:grant -- you@example.com

6. Check your setup#

Terminal
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/health?deep=1    # "status":"ok", "supabase":"ok"
npm run db:check --prefix diskarte                 # every object "present"
npm test --prefix diskarte                         # Vitest incl. PGlite RLS tests (no services needed)

Common setup issues#

Problem Fix
"Missing configuration" notice A required variable is missing or malformed (LIVEKIT_URL must start with ws:// or wss://; the anon key must be ≥ 20 chars)
Sign-in loops back to /login SITE_URL doesn't match the URL in the browser, or the callback URL isn't in Supabase's redirect list
Messages only appear after refresh Realtime public access is still on and you're testing against production rules, or migrations weren't applied (they add tables to the publication)
403 Cross-site request blocked SITE_URL port differs from the dev server's port
Voice: "Voice is not configured" LiveKit key/secret missing
Microphone blocked Use localhost or HTTPS
supabase start errors Docker isn't running

More in troubleshooting.

Next steps#

  • Repository tour and conventions
  • Architecture overview
  • Testing guide
